space: Normalised against the EXIF-CORRECTED image, 4284x5712 portrait. Every photograph in this corpus is stored 5712x4284 landscape with EXIF orientation 6, and every box in `.cache/kart/frames-named.json` is in the corrected portrait space (its width/height fields read 1000x1333). A reader that opens the JPEG without applying EXIF gets the landscape pixels and every box lands a quarter turn away. That mistake was made once while producing this file and caught by rendering the detector's own proposals, which aligned only after `ImageOps.exif_transpose`.
provenance: Hand-labelled by eye against a normalised grid over the corrected image, then verified by rendering the boxes back. Placed to support a detector-RECALL metric (does any proposal reach this item), not a localisation metric: the boxes are deliberately generous, several overlap, and the baguette's is loose because the loaf lies diagonally and these are axis-aligned. Not suitable for scoring box tightness.
judged_note: Three items carry judged=true. corpus/kart/counts.json records that on this photograph 'two of the fifteen are judged rather than read', because a shopper's woven tote lies across the middle; the Fuji and yellow produce bags are those two. Broccoli is a third, listed there as 'a bagged green, label not legible'. Report recall both with and without them.

items.name: Fuji apple bag
items.note: MISPLACED, and left in place rather than moved on a guess. This box is on a Reduced Waste bag of tomatoes and greens, not Fuji apples. On IMG_0252 the Fuji apple bag is the purple bag carrying a FUJI label, and IMG_0254 has a purple bag too, so the Fuji is most likely that. Moving it needs a reading of the photograph at full size, not an inference from the other one. Any reached/isolated figure for this item is unreliable.

items.name: yellow produce bag
items.note: Tightened to exclude the purple bag above it, which the earlier box included. Isolation figures for this item taken before that are optimistic.

known_faults: The Fuji apple bag box is misplaced; see its note. Figures for it are unreliable.

IMG_0254 contains a purple produce bag that counts.json does not list, so a box overlapping it can score as isolated when it is not. The yellow produce bag box was tightened for exactly this reason; other boxes near the trolley's middle may be flattered the same way.
